# Feature catalogue

<!-- Generated by `python -m churn.features.registry` from src/churn/features/registry.py. Do not edit. -->

All features are computed per active subscriber for one `as_of` date by the SQL in `sql/features/`. A row is visible only if its event time is before `as_of` and it was loaded on or before `as_of` (no leakage, R2.3).

Missing data (R2.4): counts default to 0; rates, deltas and recencies stay NULL; each domain has a `has_<domain>` indicator. LightGBM reads NULLs natively, so no subscriber errors out.

Tenure truncation: windows of brand-new subscribers are truncated to their tenure. A recent window is `min(tenure, w)` days long and the prior window is `min(w, max(tenure - w, 0))` days long; trends are normalised by those lengths and are NULL when the prior window is empty. `email_click_slope_90` is truncated the same way, in whole weeks: n = min(13, floor(tenure_days / 7)), fitted over `[as_of - 7n days, as_of)` with week index w = 0..n-1 (oldest to newest), slope = SUM((w - (n-1)/2) * clicks_w) / (n * (n*n - 1) / 12); it is NULL when n < 2 or there are no email events in those n weeks.

Leading indicators (ARCHITECTURE 6.2) are marked **leading**.

| Feature | Windows | Description | Missing data | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tenure_days` | point in time | Days since the subscription started | never missing |  |
| `price_usd` | point in time | Subscription price per shipment | never missing |  |
| `interval_days` | point in time | Days between shipments | never missing |  |

## subscription_events

| Feature | Windows | Description | Missing data | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `has_subscription_events` | point in time | 1 if any subscription event exists before as_of | never missing |  |
| `skip_count_60` | 60 d | Skips in the 60 days before as_of | 0 |  |
| `skip_rate_60_vs_prior_60` | last 60 d vs prior 60 d | Skips per scheduled shipment (skips / (skips + orders)) in the last 60 days minus the same rate in the prior 60 days | NULL when either window has no scheduled shipments | **leading** trend |
| `skip_count_trend` | last 60 d vs prior 60 d | Skips per 60 days in the recent 60 days minus the prior 60 days, each window normalised by min(tenure, 60) | NULL when there is no prior window yet (tenure <= 60 days) | **leading** trend |
| `blend_switch_count_90` | 90 d | Blend switches in the 90 days before as_of | 0 | **leading** |
| `blend_switch_count_365` | 365 d | Blend switches in the 365 days before as_of | 0 |  |
| `blend_switch_rate_change` | last 90 d vs prior 90 d | Blend switches per 90 days in the recent 90 days minus the prior 90 days, each window normalised by min(tenure, 90) | NULL when there is no prior window yet (tenure <= 90 days) | **leading** trend |
| `pause_events_180` | 180 d | Pauses in the 180 days before as_of | 0 |  |

## email

| Feature | Windows | Description | Missing data | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `has_email` | point in time | 1 if any email event exists before as_of | never missing |  |
| `email_unsubscribed` | point in time | 1 if the subscriber ever unsubscribed from email | 0 |  |
| `email_open_rate_90` | 90 d | Opens / sends in the 90 days before as_of | NULL when no sends |  |
| `email_open_rate_delta_30_90` | last 30 d vs days 31-90 | Open rate over the last 30 days minus the open rate over days 31 to 90 (disjoint windows) | NULL when either window has no sends | **leading** trend |
| `email_click_slope_90` | 90 d | Least-squares slope of weekly email clicks (clicks per week, per week) over the last 13 weeks, truncated to the n = min(13, floor(tenure_days / 7)) whole weeks inside the tenure | NULL when n < 2 (tenure under 14 days) or when there are no email events in the n weeks | **leading** trend |
